subject: Tree Ordinance Revisions
overview: The subcommittee conducted a line-by-line review of the draft tree ordinance (Paper 19-070), considering definitions, applicability, tree committee functions, and penalty structures. The subcommittee voted on several referrals to city departments and legal counsel to refine the draft before bringing it forward.

items.title: Call to order and introductory remarks
items.summary: Council President Morell convened the meeting to review and refine proposed edits to the draft tree ordinance before seeking administrative feedback.

items.title: Intent and public versus private tree protections
items.summary: The subcommittee discussed separating public and private tree regulations, noting that public shade trees are already covered under state statute.

items.title: Purpose narrative legal review
items.summary: Voted to request KP Law or legal counsel review the introductory narrative paragraph regarding mature tree canopies.

items.title: Role of the proposed tree committee
items.summary: The subcommittee evaluated the establishment of an appointed tree committee, discussing its scope and potential administrative friction.

items.title: Definitions: Code enforcement officer
items.summary: Voted to strike the definition of code enforcement officer from the draft ordinance so general municipal definitions govern the term.

items.title: Definitions: Protected tree diameter
items.summary: Voted to ask the Department of Public Works whether the protected tree threshold should be set at six or eight inches.

items.title: Definitions: Pruning and private ways
items.summary: Voted to seek a definition of pruning from the tree warden and request a legal opinion regarding the inclusion of private ways in the public tree definition.

items.title: Applicability: Affordable housing
items.summary: Voted to refer the applicability section governing low- and moderate-income housing to the Office of Planning, Development, and Sustainability for a policy recommendation.

items.title: Non-applicability: Invasive species
items.summary: Voted to exempt trees on the Massachusetts prohibited plant list in the non-applicability section of the ordinance.

items.title: Sections 4 and 5 review
items.summary: Voted to ask relevant departments whether the proposed statutory additions to the tree warden and code enforcement officer roles are necessary.

items.title: Tree committee duties and arborist requirement
items.summary: Voted to solicit legal review on committee enforcement authority and ask the tree warden whether the proposed arborist credential requirement is overly restrictive.

items.title: Tree replacement language
items.summary: Voted to request suggested replacement-tree language from the tree warden and the planning department.

items.title: Public feedback and residential exemptions
items.summary: Voted to attach written resident comments to the committee report for departmental review, following discussion of homeowner waivers and mitigation fees in neighbouring cities.

items.title: Permit process, penalties, and reporting out
items.summary: The subcommittee debated per-day penalty structures and voted to report the draft out with attached questions for departmental and legal feedback.
